title: ElixirConf 2023 - José Valim - The foundations of the Elixir type system
summary: José Valim's ElixirConf US 2023 closing keynote on the foundations of the Elixir type system, covering set-theoretic types and gradual typing with strong arrows.
why: HN recommends it as the best detailed explanation from the language's creator of how Elixir's new type system works and why.

quote.text: If you're into watching talks, this will be well worth your time.
